day.headline: A Rooster day — Ox and Snake are in step.

reasons: Rooster's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Someone asks how you pulled it off. Tell them the whole thing.

reasons: Ox and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Take it in front of everyone. No deflecting, no joke after.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Weigh in while it's still hot. Your take holds up.

reasons: Snake and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Lights low at ten tonight. Your body takes the hint.

reasons: Dragon pairs with Rooster — a harmonious day
signs.motif: a hat you never quite pull off
signs.message: Wear it tipped back today. Nobody's studying it as hard as you.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Hot water in it now. Scrub after dinner, not before.

reasons: Rabbit opposes Rooster — a day to take slowly
signs.message: You carried it for nothing. Stash it by the door tonight.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Rinse the windshield at the pump. That's enough car care today.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: It buzzed mid-sentence. Flip the phone over, finish the conversation.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That money hasn't come back. Not today's errand, let it sit.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nobody's read it yet. It keeps fine until the weekend.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: What they owe you can keep owing. Leave it alone today.
